ephemeris.source: Truncated Meeus lunar theory + low-precision Sun + IAU lunar orientation (WGCCRE 2009); checked against JPL Horizons
ephemeris.note: Accuracy about 0.02 degrees; fine for visualising illumination and comms windows, not for mission-grade planning. Angles are relative to a smooth 1737.4 km sphere (no terrain).

terrain.note: Terrain-derived values (height, slope, horizon profile, terrain occlusion) are not wired in yet. They need pipeline-derived data (see docs/DATA_FLOW.md).

yearStats.note: Year statistics are waiting on the metric definitions (docs/TODO.md Q1).

conventions.longitude: selenographic degrees, east positive, normalized to [-180, 180]
conventions.azimuth: compass bearing in degrees: north = 0, increasing toward east
conventions.elevation: degrees above the local horizontal of a smooth sphere; 90 = zenith
